## Featured Projects

### 1. ArXiv Copilot — Agentic Research Assistant

- Repository: https://github.com/anishpandey7659/Arxiv-Research-Copilot
- Category: AI / RAG
- Technologies: Python, FastAPI, OpenSearch, LiteLLM, Docling, Langfuse, Logfire

An end-to-end agentic research assistant that automatically fetches, processes, indexes, and answers questions about ArXiv research papers.

Key capabilities:

- Agentic RAG pipeline for searching, fetching, summarizing, and answering questions about research papers.
- Automated document ingestion using Docling, PDF parsing, section-based chunking, embeddings, and indexing.
- Hybrid retrieval combining BM25 and vector search.
- Multi-layer AI guardrails using rate limiting, regex filtering, and LLM-based safety checks.
- Provider-agnostic LLM routing through LiteLLM.
- Observability, tracing, latency monitoring, and token usage tracking using Langfuse and Logfire.
- Parallel paper downloading and indexing to optimize ingestion.

Project link: https://github.com/anishpandey7659/Arxiv-Research-Copilot

### 2. JobPilot AI — JobMatch Agent

- Repository: https://github.com/anishpandey7659/JobPilot-AI
- Category: AI / Agents
- Technologies: Python, LangGraph, Langfuse

An AI-powered job search agent that finds, ranks, and refines job listings and tailors resumes for selected roles.

Key capabilities:

- Multi-node LangGraph workflow for job fetching, ranking, query reformulation, resume tailoring, and validation.
- Automatic query reformulation that repeats job searches when ranked results are weak.
- Conditional entry routing to support job search and resume tailoring modes within a single graph.

Project link: https://github.com/anishpandey7659/JobPilot-AI
